heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Asteroid resource.—
tree.text: The term “asteroid resource” means a space resource found on or within a single asteroid.

children.heading: In general.—
children.text: The term “space resource” means an abiotic resource in situ in outer space.

children.heading: Inclusions.—
children.text: The term “space resource” includes water and minerals.

tree.heading: United states citizen.—
tree.text: The term “United States citizen” has the meaning given the term “citizen of the United States” in section 50902.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 114–90, title IV, § 402(a), Nov. 25, 2015, 129 Stat. 721.)
